text.body: First emergence of explicit form from implicit ground; identity established through vital connection.

properties.c_1_description: First emergence of explicit form from implicit ground; identity established through vital connection.
properties.q_0_emergence_from_archaic_silence: Before P1 can be the first explicit stance, it presupposes the implicit ground it emerges FROM — P0's Archaic non-differentiation, the irrepresentable alētheia it does not contain but crystallises out of. As the Position family's manifestation of the #1 charge (Magic / One-ness / Vital-Definition), P1's q_0 is the throw of the zero-distance behind it: 'the first explicit emergence from the implicit ground of P0' (P1.md), where P0 'stands as undifferentiated unconcealment.' P1 always already finds itself given a ground it did not make — the bindu's standing-illumination from which the first name can be struck. Its void-pole is the silent presence still pressing beneath the spell: the Magic structure, in Gebser, has barely separated from the Archaic, so that name and named, word and world, are felt as ONE — the totem IS the thing, the spell DOES what it says. This is the matheme's 0 inherited as the from-beneath of the first 1: P1 is the determinate emerging, but it stands on a non-differentiation it can never fully leave behind, the vital-connection 'without relation' (P1.md) that is only possible because the zero-distance of P0 has not yet hardened into the subject-object gap. P1's deeper throw is exactly this almost-unity: the explicit that has emerged but remembers, in its magic, that it was once not separate from its ground at all.
properties.q_1_point_like_vital_unity: What P1 IS: Mind — the Day-face of the #1 charge, 'the first explicit emergence from the implicit ground of P0,' identity FOR itself (P1.md). This is its home register and its substance. Where P0 stands as undifferentiated unconcealment, P1 is 'the point at which something can be named, the vital-connection that makes name and named hold together.' Its essential thesis: Mind here is NOT the cogito — 'it is the founding act by which a position becomes able to refer back to itself.' In the developmental spine it is Gebser's Magic Structure: point-like, pre-perspectival, the epoch of the spell, the name, the totem, where consciousness is vitally connected to world 'without relation' — not yet the subject confronting an object, but the one-point at which identity first congeals. Substantively P1 refracts #1 as 'Magic / One-ness / Vital-Definition. Point-like unity, vital connection without relation; spell, name, totem' (P1.md). It carries the matheme's A-family adjacent-identity rule (position #1): 'the (0,1) natural-dyad-pair at even-step adjacency' — the first dyad, the minimal difference, the one-mark that the zero-ground first lets stand. Its question is What? — 'not as classification, but as the very capacity for thatness to crystallise.' What P1 IS, definitionally, is the founding-act of self-reference: the magic point where a stance first becomes able to BE a stance, where the vital connection of name-and-named makes thatness possible — the one congealing out of the zero, identity for itself before it is identity for an other.
properties.q_2_vital_connection_without_relation: P1 operates by NAMING — by the vital-connection that makes name and named hold together (P1.md). Its native act is the spell: not description-of-a-thing but the magic identity in which the word DOES what it says, the totem IS what it represents. This is operation 'without relation' — the Magic structure has not yet opened the gap across which one thing could relate to another, so its dynamism is point-like fusion rather than lateral connection: the one-point of identity binding name to named in a single vital act. In the matheme P1 is the first explicit MOVE, the move from the implicit ground to the first determinate — 'the founding act by which a position becomes able to refer back to itself.' Relationally it couples adjacently: the A-pair (0,1) 'couples P1 to P0 in adjacent-identity' (P1.md), the even-step natural dyad where the one stands next to the zero it emerged from. And it grounds the next operation — P1's congealed identity is what P2 Mythic sets into MOTION when 'defined form begins to move' (P2.md), the noun whose verb P2 will be. Its cross-ref runs to subsystem: '[[M1]] (Paramasiva) actualises P1 in the subsystem-domain — the first explicit shaping out of M0' (P1.md), the same #1 charge read as the first determinate shaping wherever it manifests. P1's dynamism is the magic of self-reference: the act by which thatness first crystallises and holds, name and named fused at a single vital point before any relation has been opened between them.
properties.q_3_self_referential_point: Structurally P1 is the point — 'point-like unity' (P1.md), zero-dimensional becoming one-dimensional, the minimal determinate form. Its organising structure is self-reference: 'the founding act by which a position becomes able to refer back to itself.' This is the matheme's first explicate position — the '1' of the 0/1, the determinate mark that the void-pole lets stand, magnitude beginning to acquire the barest direction. As the Position family's #1, P1 is the first of the four explicate structures that traverse the torus surface (P1 Magic through P4 Integral, held between the implicate poles P0 and P5); its live topology is TORUS, the cyclical self-enclosing surface on which the determinate stances loop. Structurally the Magic point carries the A-family adjacent-identity rule: 'the (0,1) natural-dyad-pair at even-step adjacency' (P1.md) — the first dyad, structured as the minimal difference between ground and mark, the even-step that holds the one next to the zero. Its formal signature is the self-referential loop: a structure that can point back at itself, the first fixed point, identity-for-itself before it becomes identity-for-an-other (which is P2's polarity). The logic here is the logic of the spell — the name that organises by fusing, the totem that structures by being-the-thing rather than standing-for-it. P1 is structured as the magic point: the one congealed from the zero, the self-referential mark, the minimal determinate that the whole developmental arc will elaborate into perspective, context, and synthesis but which is, here, simply and vitally ONE.
properties.q_4_objective_entry_aperture: P1's telos is to make thatness graspable — to give the developmental arc its first nameable foothold, so that consciousness, having emerged from Archaic zero-distance, has something it can refer to, hold, invoke. Its raison d'être is the founding of self-reference: P1 exists so that 'a position becomes able to refer back to itself' (P1.md), the first determinate that makes all further determination possible. Contextually P1 is the runtime entry-surface of the family — pole of Square B (Cause-Experience axis, P1+P4), and P1.md names this exactly: 'This is the primary runtime entry surface.' It is where the system is first ENTERED, the magic point at which a process begins to refer to itself. Its L-link makes the why precise: P1 is refracted by the L1<->L4' lens pair — 'L1 (Causal — Aristotle's four causes / Icchā Śakti / Schopenhauer's Will) reveals P1 as why-things-happen grounded in absolute will,' while 'L4' (Scientific — Kuhn paradigm) gives P1 its objective-entry-aperture as explicit methodology-of-investigation' (P1.md). So P1's purpose is doubly inflected: it is both the will-grounded why-things-happen (the vital impulse of the spell, the Magic structure's felt potency) AND the objective entry-aperture where investigation begins. Its Thought-residency: 'the Mind family. The Day-Night braid runs through /Thought/Thrownness/ where vital-connection meets factical-constraint' (P1.md) — the magic of naming meeting the thrownness of being-already-in-a-world. P1's why is graspability: to be the first nameable stance, the entry-point, the magic foothold from which the whole arc can be walked.
properties.q_5_name_handed_to_motion: P1's synthesis is its self-giving into motion — the magic point completes by being set going. Read as the Position family's #1, P1's closure is the handover to P2: its congealed identity, 'the point at which something can be named' (P1.md), is precisely what P2 Mythic takes up when 'defined form begins to move... P2 sets identity into operation' (P2.md). The name P1 strikes is the noun whose verb P2 becomes; Magic's static fusion hands itself to Mythic's narrative force. But P1 also participates in the family's larger Mobius through its complementary pair: 'P1 <-> P4 (Son — incarnation, sums to 5)' (P1.md), the Magic point bound across the arc to the Integral lemniscate — the first determinate and the aperspectival fold as the two ends of one complementary axis (Square B, Cause-Experience). And its cross-helix Mobius partner is P1' Need, 'lack-as-demand' (P1.md): the Day-face's magic fullness (the spell that HAS its object by naming it) inverting into the Night-face's lack (the demand that arises from not-having). So P1's synthesis-register holds both — the completion that hands the name forward into Mythic motion, and the completion that turns, across the Klein twist, into its own inversion. P1 OPENS rather than concludes because the one is never the whole: the minimal determinate, having crystallised, immediately requires the operation (P2), the pattern (P3), the context (P4), the synthesis (P5) that it cannot itself supply. The spell, once spoken, must move — and the magic point, having founded self-reference, hands its vital unity on to the field of forces that will set it into narrative. P1's last act is its first gift: the name, struck, becomes the verb it was always about to do.
